scope: PR #9 proxide-tmalign Phase 2: crates/proxide-tmalign/src/{lib.rs,nwdp_tm.rs,ss.rs,refine.rs,pipeline.rs,d0.rs,score.rs,seed/*.rs}, tests/test_parity_pdb1_pdb2.rs, tests/common/mod.rs, src/bin/tmalign.rs vs .praxia/docs/specs/260729_proxide-tmalign-phases-2-5.md and .praxia/docs/research/260729_tm-align-phase-2-algorithm-map.md

issues.issue: n_aligned is computed as the raw count of non-gap pairs in the chosen alignment map (coords1_aligned.len()), not the score_d8-distance-filtered n_ali8/Lali the reference binary reports (per research doc's own §4 description of the final stage: 'Select pairs with dist <= score_d8 ... for final rmsd0=sqrt(rmsd/n_ali8)'). Empirically, rust n_aligned=163 is nearly equal to ylen=166 (consistent with counting the full/raw alignment path), while reference Lali=119 is the filtered subset -- this strongly suggests the addendum's 'still-open empirical gap ... likely something more structural in the DP/NWDP_TM convergence dynamics, not yet root-caused' characterization (research doc lines 48-56) is probably wrong: it looks like a metric-definition mismatch (raw alignment length vs distance-filtered length), not a convergence/algorithmic divergence. Recommend re-scoping the backlog follow-up to 'filter final alignment by score_d8 before reporting n_aligned' before spending a dedicated debugging session chasing DP convergence.

The parity harness never actually executes in CI. load_usalign_sample() returns None when ~/repos/USalign (or $USALIGN_REPO) isn't present, and both #[test] fns in test_parity_pdb1_pdb2.rs early-return (reported PASS, zero assertions run) in that case. Neither PDB1.pdb/PDB2.pdb nor any tests/data/ directory is committed to the repo (confirmed via `find . -iname PDB1.pdb` -> no results), directly contradicting the spec's explicit design: 'Commit a small set of permissively-licensed (public-domain RCSB) PDB structure pairs directly under tests/data/ -- no env-var gating needed for the inputs ... only for the regeneration step.' CI runs `cargo test --workspace` (ci.yml:92) with no local USalign clone, so the PR's claimed 'first honest parity-verified milestone' is not actually enforced by CI -- only verifiable on a machine that happens to have ~/repos/USalign cloned. Also missing vs spec: tests/regen_parity_consts.rs (env-gated drift check) and 2-3 fixture pairs (spec asks for 2-3; only 1 pair -- PDB1/PDB2 -- plus a self-alignment permutation of it -- is present).

score_alignment() -- the pre-DP_iter seed-admission gate (TM > TMmax*0.2 / TMmax*ddcc) -- uses a single naive whole-alignment Kabsch fit with no distance filtering, not the reference's detailed_search/TMscore8_search-based gate score (research doc §4: every seed transition in TMalign_main is gated on a TMscore8_search-refined score). This is disclosed in commit ae8e252's message ('Known approximation to revisit...') and cross-referenced in test_parity_pdb1_pdb2.rs's doc comment, but not flagged in pipeline.rs's own doc comments at the definition site -- a reader of just the source wouldn't know this is a deliberate temporary approximation. Additionally, the function's own outer doc comment ('Computes TM-score ... running three iterations of distance-filtered re-fitting (same as get_score_fast)') contradicts what the body actually does (one Kabsch fit, no filtering) -- looks like a stale/copy-pasted docstring left over from an earlier draft that called get_score_fast.

Two 'not yet landed' status blurbs from the Phase 1 scaffold are now false and were not updated by this PR. lib.rs's crate doc says 'Not yet landed: the 5 TM-align initial-seeding strategies, the iterative DP_iter refinement loop ... and the parallel/pairwise-batch APIs' -- the first two are landed by this PR. seed/mod.rs's run_seed doc says alignments are 'later refined via DP_iter (not yet landed -- a separate follow-up module)' -- also landed (crates/proxide-tmalign/src/refine.rs exists and is wired into pipeline.rs). Misleading to a future reader about the crate's completion state.

Both the addendum and the bathos experiment's pass-outcome decision text cite 'backlog #3788' as the tracking mechanism for the open n_aligned gap, but no such backlog item exists: grepped every accessible .praxia/backlog.jsonl (main proxide repo + every worktree under .claude/worktrees/), max existing backlog id is 1408, no id 3788 present anywhere. The 'flagged as follow-up work ... see backlog' claim in the addendum isn't actually backed by a trackable item in this repo.

nw.rs's module doc claims needleman_wunsch_affine is 'used both to seed low-identity/secondary-structure-based initial alignments and inside TM-align's DP_iter refinement loop' -- grep confirms it is called nowhere outside its own unit tests; every seed and refine::dp_iter actually use the separate simplified-Gotoh nwdp_tm core (nwdp_tm.rs's own doc correctly describes this). Dead production code with a misleading module doc; also contains `.partial_cmp(...).unwrap()` (line 82) that would panic on a NaN score input -- latent only since unreachable from the live pipeline, but worth a doc fix or removal so a future caller doesn't get bitten.

smooth() (USalign's SS-letter post-processing pass, TMalign.h:693-735) is not ported and its omission isn't mentioned anywhere in ss.rs's doc comments, unlike the crate's own established practice elsewhere of flagging deliberate omissions inline (e.g. fragment_gapless.rs's 'fast_opt not yet exposed in this version'). The research doc's addendum already flags that smooth()'s call site couldn't be found in TMalign_main and it may be dead code -- but that caveat should be carried into ss.rs itself so a reader doesn't have to cross-reference the research doc to know this was a deliberate, reasoned omission rather than an oversight.

TmAlignResult omits rmsd and seq_id1/seq_id2/seq_id_ali present in the spec's own example struct (specs/260729_proxide-tmalign-phases-2-5.md's 'Core result type' block). Disclosed in commit ae8e252's message as a deliberate Phase-2 deferral ('per the phase plan'), but the spec's phase-sequencing section doesn't explicitly scope rmsd/seqID to a later phase (only TM3/4/5 are explicitly gated on optional CLI flags not yet built) -- no addendum was added to the spec doc recording this narrowing, unlike the research doc's own addendum practice for the 6 numerical fixes. Not a defect, but the deferral isn't spec-traceable without reading git log.

strengths: All 5 seeding strategies (gapless, SS, local-structure, ss_plus, fragment-gapless) plus DP_iter and the full tmalign_pair_serial gated sequence are implemented and match the research doc's algorithm map closely, including several easy-to-miss quirks explicitly called out as must-replicate (simplified-Gotoh free leading-gap boundary, score_fun8's score_d8 gating, squared-distance-not-sqrt scoring, >= tie-breaks, get_score_fast's genuine while(1) escalation loop, DP_iter's t/u persistence across gap_open passes seeded via tmscore8_search not naive Kabsch).

The 6 previously-found numerical bugs are visibly fixed with explanatory in-code comments at each fix site (e.g. refine.rs:296-320's detailed t/u persistence rationale, local_structure.rs:130-134's squared-vs-unsquared note, gapless.rs:87-89's >= tie-break note) -- good code-honesty practice for the fixes that were made.

The parity test file and bathos .bth.toml are unusually forthright about the empirically-loosened tolerance (0.01 vs the spec's 1e-4 target) and the open n_aligned gap -- this is not a silently-passing test dressed up as strict; the gap is named and quantified in three places (addendum, test file doc comment, bathos toml).
fast_opt is consistently and correctly hardcoded off (matching TMalign's own non--fast default) rather than half-implemented; fragment_gapless.rs explicitly notes this design choice inline.
next_action: Before treating Phase 2 as closed: (1) investigate whether n_aligned should be redefined as the score_d8-filtered count rather than raw alignment length -- this looks like the actual root cause of the 'n_aligned gap', not a DP convergence issue; (2) commit the PDB1.pdb/PDB2.pdb fixtures (or equivalent permissively-licensed pairs) under tests/data/ so the parity harness actually runs in CI, or add a CI step that fetches/builds USalign so the milestone claim is enforced, not just locally verifiable; (3) fix or remove the dangling 'backlog #3788' references; (4) update lib.rs/seed/mod.rs's stale 'not yet landed' doc blurbs.
